cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Financial Analyst, Manufacturing Operations role in Chelmsford. The posting asks for someone who can reconcile and interpret data, run recurring weekly reporting accurately, support the monthly and quarterly close, and build automation and analytics that improve the reporting process. That is close to what I do now.

As Financial Manager at AMG Family Dental in Belmont, I build the annual operating budget and monthly forecasts, produce budget-vs-actual variance analysis and KPI reports for ownership, and oversee billing, collections and revenue tracking. By improving financial reporting and reconciliation processes in Dentrix, I identified and recovered more than $500K in annual revenue. I also automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation with Python, cutting processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagging underpaid claims for follow-up. I reduced A/R aging by 10% by tightening claim submission and follow-up.

At Northrop Grumman I was a Financial Analyst Intern in Sunnyvale. I audited more than 100 financial models for accuracy, compliance and internal controls, analyzed material pricing, supplier costs and budget variances across multiple programs, and presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership. I tracked program costs in SAP and Deltek Cobra and kept the data accurate. That experience with cost data in an industrial setting is why a plant finance role in a semiconductor manufacturer appeals to me.

My degrees are an M.A. in International Economics and Finance (STEM) from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration with a finance major from Suffolk. My skills include advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Tableau and SAP. I am a U.S. citizen, so the ADFED citizenship requirement is not a barrier, and I am available immediately.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support the Chelmsford finance team.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
